text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] CustomerFacing-GenerateErrors firing for service=model-serving-prod, severity=page. error_rate > 5% for 5m. paging #eng-oncall

alex: ack, I'm on it — taking first look now. any idea if this is global or region-specific?

maria: i'm seeing it mostly in eu-west-1. spike started ~09:12 UTC, affects ~10% of requests to the gated-model route. internal 502s and 504s in the logs. customers reporting failed completions.

chris: adding quick check: `kubectl logs -n prod model-serving-*, --tail=200 | grep "502" | wc -l` shows a sharp jump at 09:12. looks like a backend timeout cascade.

alex: thanks. i'll open an immediate mitigation: shift traffic to model-variant `gated-model-v1` fallback and increase request timeout to 12s on the edge for affected route. doing canary first.

maria: +1. canary rollout started. pinging ops to scale GPU pool by 2 nodes in eu-west while we validate.

incident-bot: deployment-canary: rollout started for gated-model-fallback (canary=5%).

jamal: i'm monitoring customer impact dashboard: https://redwood.infra/dashboards/err-rate?panel=customer-failures&range=30m — seeing correlated increase in support mentions. Notify CS?

alex: yes, pinged @support-ops with an incident note (high-level): "Spike in generation errors eu-west impacting completions. Mitigating with fallback + node scale. ETA 15-20m."

chris: mitigation looks healthy so far — canary error rate down from 8.2% -> 2.1% in 3m. starting 50% rollout.

maria: note for post-incident root cause: there was a KV cache eviction storm around 09:10 causing downstream slowdown on specific shard. we'll correlate with `kv-evict` metrics.

alex: handoff to maria for the next 30m — i'm OOO for a quick lunch. maria please continue the rollout and confirm customer recovery, then file post-incident items. :coffee:

maria: taking over. will also update alerts and runbook after we stabilize.

incident-bot: Alert CustomerFacing-GenerateErrors recovered at 1719457042 (error_rate now 0.9%). Alert closed.

chris: for after-action: propose alert tuning so we don't page on short-lived cache storms. PR with rule suggestion: require 10% error for 10m or 5% sustained for 30m, plus add `region:by` label to avoid global pages. sample rule:

```
# suggested: only page when sustained or regional
expr: sum by (region) (rate(request_errors_total[10m])) / sum by (region) (rate(request_total[10m])) > 0.10
for: 10m
labels:
  severity: page
  owner: eng-oncall
```

chris: will open PR in infra-alerts: https://git.redwood/infra/alerts/pulls/452 (draft).

jamal: also propose a compact customer-impact dashboard that combines err-rate, support mentions, and top failing routes. i'll draft a dashboard and link in the runbook.

maria: created a runbook edit issue with context and ownership: https://git.redwood/infra/runbooks/issues/129 — includes links to dashboard, PR, and quick mitigation steps (fallback rollout, scale, verify). assigning to `eng-oncall` for ownership.

sre-lead: thanks team. action items before close:
- (alex) confirm the canary->full rollout completed (or note rollback).
- (chris) finalize alert PR and add annotation to the alert rule explaining the tuning rationale.
- (jamal) create dashboard and add link to runbook issue.
- (maria) write a 1-paragraph impact summary for the post-incident doc and tag affected customers.

alex: confirmed full rollout completed at 09:22 UTC, no rollback.

chris: PR opened as draft 452, will move to ready after tag and tests. added a brief changelog note.

jamal: dashboard draft: https://redwood.infra/dashboards/err-rate/draft-211 — will move to shared after review.

maria: writing the impact summary now in the post-incident doc: https://git.redwood/infra/incidents/2024-09-26-gated-model-evict. will add link to support tickets.

sre-lead: nice run. once PR & dashboard are merged, mark the runbook issue done and add `last-reviewed` annotation with today's date. Also add a short blurb to oncall playbook about regional pages vs global pages.

maria: will do. tagging the runbook owner and setting ownership to `eng-oncall` in the runbook frontmatter.

alex: :thumbsup: great work everyone. closing thread when runbook is updated.

incident-bot: Note added to incident timeline: mitigation=canary-fallback, scale=+2 nodes, alert-tuning-proposal=452.
